items.headline: Albemarle Corporation to Release Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation (NYSE: ALB) will release third quarter 2026 earnings results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Reset Lithium Assumptions
items.snippet: The future P/E multiple has changed from 11.57x to 10.30x and the discount rate from 7.41% to 7.50% as analysts reset lithium assumptions.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand is up 45% through May, primarily driven by continued strength in stationary storage. Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply; we exited the second quarter near record lows in terms of days of lithium salts inventory.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 7.8% and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in the first half of 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15%-to-40% forecast range. Stationary storage is driving the gap.
